environment.description: Go 1.19 microservice deployed on EKS cluster (Kubernetes 1.24) in namespace 'proxy-services'. Pod runs with default service account. No NetworkPolicy objects applied to the namespace. ALB Ingress exposes /proxy, /metrics, and /token endpoints publicly. Pod has unrestricted egress to all IPs including 169.254.169.254. IMDSv1 is enabled on the EC2 nodes (no hop limit enforcement). Go 1.19's net/http does NOT strip CRLF characters from Header.Set() values.
